# Create fusion cores without flux

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_57_nukaknights-post-fusionskerne-ohne-flux.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

#### Did you know that every weapon you craft goes into your inventory with ammunition? I honestly don't.

Most people probably know that, in addition to collecting and capturing power plants, you can also create fusion cores at the chemical workbench. However, you need one of each stable flux to create a fusion core. This can also be done differently:

- 
 **Super Duper** equip under Luck
- 
 You should have learned the **Gatling Laser blueprint**
- 
 Equipping **Professional Scientist** to 2 under Intelligence saves approximately 20% material when producing energy weapons
- 
 Go to the **weapon workbench** to craft
- 
 Heavy Weapons -> Select **Gatling Laser**
- 
 Create Gatling Lasers at the lowest level
- 
 For each Gatling laser production, **1-2 lasers including fusion cores** end up in the inventory
- 
 Scrap Gatling Laser again

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9LR3wag_gFM

**Gatling Laser Plan**: You can get it from the Brotherhood Bot in the Whitespring Resort, in the Whitespring Bunker at Modus at the Armory Terminal and at Phoenix in the Watoga Shopping Plaza.

https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Plan:_Gatling_laser
